note: Hand-curated major New England movable bridges with published opening rules in 33 CFR Part 117 Subpart B. Coordinates are [lon, lat] from OpenStreetMap/Nominatim or reviewed by hand. Opening summaries paraphrase the federal regulation; the sourceUrl links the governing section.

bridges.name: Chelsea Street Bridge
bridges.openingRule: Opens on signal; tankers and tugs can request either a 139-foot or full 175-foot lift.

bridges.name: Fore River Bridge
bridges.openingRule: Opens on signal except weekday rush hours 6:30–9 a.m. and 4:30–6:30 p.m.; vessels over 10,000 gross tons pass at any time.

bridges.name: Cape Cod Canal Railroad Bridge
bridges.openingRule: Normally kept fully open; lowered only for trains or maintenance, with horn signals before each move.

bridges.name: Andrew J. Gillis Memorial Bridge
bridges.openingRule: May 1–November 15, 6 a.m.–10 p.m. opens on signal (top and bottom of the hour in peak summer); otherwise one hour's notice.

bridges.name: Kernwood Bridge
bridges.openingRule: Opens on signal; overnight and winter evening openings need one hour's advance notice, holidays need advance notice.

bridges.name: Beverly Draw (MBTA/Amtrak)
bridges.openingRule: Opens on signal; midnight–5 a.m. and on December 25 and January 1 opens within one hour of notice.

bridges.name: Blynman Bridge
bridges.openingRule: Opens on signal; Thanksgiving afternoon, Christmas and New Year's periods need two hours' notice.

bridges.name: Craigie Bridge (Charles River Dam)
bridges.openingRule: Opens on signal except weekday rush hours; winter openings need 24 hours' notice, shoulder-season overnight openings 8 hours.

bridges.name: Alford Street Bridge
bridges.openingRule: Opens on signal except weekday morning and evening rush windows; November–March evening openings need eight hours' notice.

bridges.name: Veterans Memorial Bridge
bridges.openingRule: Opens on signal 7 a.m.–3 p.m.; otherwise two hours' advance notice.

bridges.name: New Bedford–Fairhaven Bridge
bridges.openingRule: Opens on the hour 6–10 a.m. and at quarter past the hour 11:15 a.m.–6:15 p.m.; on request at other times; deep-draft vessels any time.

bridges.name: Connecticut River Amtrak Bridge
bridges.openingRule: Opens as soon as practicable for vessels that cannot pass beneath, within 20 minutes of a request.

bridges.name: East Haddam Swing Bridge
bridges.openingRule: May–October opens on signal for commercial vessels and on the hour 6 a.m.–8 p.m. for recreational boats; overnight winter openings need six hours' notice.

bridges.name: Thames River Amtrak Bridge
bridges.openingRule: Opens on signal to 75 feet, or a full 135-foot lift on request; other vessels within 20 minutes; trains already approaching cross first.

bridges.name: Washington Bridge
bridges.openingRule: Opens on signal except 7–9 a.m. and 4–5:45 p.m.; December–March overnight openings need six hours' notice.

bridges.name: Devon Bridge (Metro-North)
bridges.openingRule: Opens with two hours' notice by day and four hours' notice at night; closed to boats in weekday rush periods except emergencies.

bridges.name: Tomlinson Bridge
bridges.openingRule: Opens on signal except short weekday windows around morning, midday, and evening commutes.

bridges.name: Walk Bridge (Metro-North)
bridges.openingRule: Opens with two hours' notice by day and four hours' notice at night; closed to boats in weekday rush periods except emergencies.

bridges.name: Saugatuck River Railroad Bridge (SAGA)
bridges.openingRule: Opens with two hours' notice 4:30 a.m.–9 p.m. and four hours' notice overnight; no rush-hour openings except emergencies.

bridges.name: Cos Cob Bridge (Metro-North)
bridges.openingRule: Opens with two hours' notice 4:30 a.m.–9 p.m. and four hours' notice overnight; no rush-hour openings except emergencies.

bridges.name: Mystic River Bascule Bridge
bridges.openingRule: May–October opens hourly at twenty minutes before the hour, 7:40 a.m.–6:40 p.m.; winter opens on signal by day and with six hours' notice overnight.

bridges.name: Memorial Bridge
bridges.openingRule: Opens on signal; May 15–October 31, 7 a.m.–7 p.m. smaller vessels get openings only on the hour and half hour.

bridges.name: Sarah Mildred Long Bridge
bridges.carries: U.S. Route 1 Bypass and rail (Portsmouth NH–Kittery ME)
bridges.openingRule: Opens on signal; May 15–October 31, 7 a.m.–7 p.m. smaller vessels get openings only at quarter of and quarter past the hour.

bridges.name: Carlton Bridge
bridges.openingRule: Opens on signal by day; evening and overnight openings need two hours' notice in summer and 8–24 hours' notice in winter.

bridges.name: Lake Champlain Drawbridge (US 2)
bridges.openingRule: May 15–October 15, 8 a.m.–8 p.m. opens on the hour and half hour; otherwise four hours' notice.
